successors.name: Commonwealth of Australia
successors.text: the Territory of Papua: 'place our Possession of British New Guinea under the authority of the Commonwealth of Australia'

ledger.x: 1884: Britain proclaims a protectorate over south-eastern New Guinea.
1888: the protectorate becomes a Crown colony: 'On 4 September 1888, McGregor formally proclaimed the south-eastern portion of New Guinea as a Crown colony.'
1906: British New Guinea becomes the Australian Territory of Papua.

certainty.note: Only the sea coast and the Dutch line are named; the northern boundary with the German protectorate was undefined until the 1885 draft.

The northern frontier is a treaty line: the 1885 draft agreement 'formalised in the 1886 Anglo-German Declarations' on the page; the Dutch boundary is not described, and the interior of the colony was unexplored for years.
